# mtncloud_mos_buckets (Data Source)

Lists the tenant's MOS buckets, sorted by name, with their console records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_mos_buckets" "all" {}

output "bucket_names" {
  value = data.mtncloud_mos_buckets.all.buckets[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) The buckets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))
- `id` (String) Always `mos-buckets`.

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `console_id` (String) Its console bucket record's ID (the `mtncloud_mos_bucket` ID), or null when it isn't in the console.
- `console_name` (String) Its name in the console, or null.
- `creation_date` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) The bucket's name in MOS.
